requirements.text: Independent knowledge facts may append concurrently without losing either accepted record.
requirements.verify: integration/concurrency: concurrently persist independent facts through actual storage and read both via a fresh service; no unnecessary global overwrite or missing record.

requirements.text: A correction must supersede only the intended claim, preserve author/evidence lineage and permitted history, expose the current accepted revision, and keep unresolved contradictions visible.
requirements.verify: integration: correct one real saved claim beside unrelated knowledge; verify supersession chain/history/current recall and unchanged unrelated record, with disputed claims not hidden or treated as certain.

requirements.text: Deduplication must stay within permitted scope/source/subject boundaries and must not merge claims solely by embedding similarity or reveal cross-tenant file existence.
requirements.verify: unit/integration/security: exercise similar values from separate sources/scopes and permitted identical retries; inspect responses and canonical records for correct nonmerging and no cross-tenant existence disclosure.

requirements.text: Memory correction and retrieved/model content must not publish executable methods, behavior profiles, approvals or protected completion evidence.
requirements.verify: security/integration: save/correct adversarial memory and edit a generated context proposal; inspect owners/call counters to prove no behavior release, grant, check receipt or controller completion is created.

requirements.text: Eligibility must be checked before source content reaches answer generation, model input, reranking or external embedding/enrichment.
requirements.verify: integration/security: populate eligible and forbidden stored sources, capture actual generator/reranker/enrichment inputs, and verify only currently eligible content crosses each supported boundary.

requirements.text: Output publication/disclosure must recheck current source and full output-audience permission; a previously valid context snapshot cannot bypass deletion or revoked authority.
requirements.verify: integration/concurrency/security: pause a real answer after eligible retrieval, then delete/revoke or change audience before disclosure; no subsequent disallowed answer/manifest publication, while unchanged eligible publication succeeds.

requirements.text: A permitted RetrievalManifest must expose Space/audience, membership/policy revisions, selected memory/knowledge versions, source revisions/digests, index watermark, actual profile and inclusion reasons.
requirements.verify: integration: inspect manifests from actual saved-decision answers, delayed-index and restored journeys; all fields identify the real selected records/current authority and hidden titles/content are absent.

requirements.text: Newly committed eligible knowledge must remain retrievable through authorized exact/tail retrieval when a derived index lags or is unavailable, with material recall limitations disclosed.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery: commit a decision with indexing paused, delayed and failed; retrieve real canonical bytes before index repair, observe watermark/limitation and no permission bypass.

requirements.text: Answers without sufficient evidence must state the gap or request a permitted source; historical remedies and semantic similarity cannot be presented as current live machine state or factual proof.
requirements.verify: integration: ask with absent/expired/disputed evidence and a historical record; assert explicit safe limitation/next action and no fabricated saved decision or live-inspection result.

requirements.text: Caches, search scopes and context fingerprints must remain tenant/Space/audience/version-aware; shared billing affiliation must not merge knowledge or bypass current authority.
requirements.verify: security/integration: use same billing team across rooms, stale populated caches, permission/source revisions and revocation; inspect allowed outputs and generator inputs for zero cross-scope leakage.

requirements.text: Unavailable enrichment/indexing must preserve acknowledged canonical knowledge and defer derived work; a late summarizer must not replace a current profile using an older revision.
requirements.verify: integration/concurrency/recovery: fail enrichment after canonical commit, recreate processor and process an older queued summary after correction; original acknowledged record survives and accepted head is not silently overwritten.

requirements.text: Any supported model, summarization, embedding, enrichment or reranking invocation must retain approved source/provider/region policy and explicit Task or maintenance budget admission using the existing owner.
requirements.verify: integration/security/review: demonstrate stored-source Ask composition with installed identity/model/budget owners; deny stale/ineligible profiles or missing budgets before local call, inspect original binding/manifest, and label paid or unsupported calls as disabled.

requirements.text: In the finite F05 local profile, an authorized Personal-chat Ask about a saved decision must produce a source-grounded answer from actual eligible persisted content without starting a Space VM.
requirements.verify: e2e/integration: explicitly save a decision, recreate service, Ask what was decided, assert selected stored bytes affect the answer and permitted source/version manifest, and observe zero Space-computer starts; deterministic answer path is labelled local.

requirements.text: Ordinary Ask must run through the native conversation service route with no Space filesystem or unrestricted shell and no target-file mutation or external write.
requirements.verify: integration/security: exercise real saved-decision service routing and source broker calls; inspect supplied capabilities/dispatches and test attempted file/shell/effect proposals are denied with zero target writes.

requirements.text: Ordinary Ask must cause zero provision, wake, mount and computer-dispatch calls across allowed, denied, unavailable-index, service-failure, concurrent and restored journeys.
requirements.verify: integration/concurrency/recovery: instrument the actual service/computer boundary and run each listed journey; assert each computer-route counter is zero while authorized answers remain useful.

requirements.text: Computer/live inspection must require an explicit declared capability and controller-owned visible transition; service failure must not silently mount another disk or fall back to local compute or an unapproved region.
requirements.verify: integration/security: request unsupported live inspection and inject service failures; verify safe refusal/capability next action and no hidden computer, disk, local-host or unapproved-route dispatch.

requirements.text: Ask/save/recall operations must resolve recorded immutable conversation/Task tenant and Space bindings rather than a mutable current tab; switching Space must not migrate queued work, storage or credentials.
requirements.verify: integration/concurrency: queue an Ask/save in Space A, switch to B, complete and recreate service; A retains original binding, B sees only permitted records and forged currentSpace does not change authority.

requirements.text: Source attachment, older-conversation recall and saving reusable memories must be independently controlled; disabling recall or save must not silently change same-Space file grants or mandatory transcript/audit retention.
requirements.verify: unit/integration: exercise each supported setting independently and in combination, inspect selected content and created canonical records, and verify task-only/no-save behavior plus truthful filesystem/retention explanation.

requirements.text: Remember here must target the current authorized Space; any supported Remember for me inside a group must be an explicit export/audience-checked group-to-personal copy.
requirements.verify: integration/security: save to the resolved personal/group binding; if copy is supported, test allowed/denied export, otherwise refuse it explicitly; no silent private extraction or new source grant.

requirements.text: Basic declared retention must apply to every supported retained content class, with validity/expiry enforced for recall and publication.
requirements.verify: integration: inventory retention classes, advance an explicit fixture clock/duration, and verify eligible-before/expired-after behavior for real canonical records, files and supported derivatives.

requirements.text: Forget/delete and local storage restore must check their own current operation grants; room membership or read/contributor access alone must not grant lifecycle or policy administration powers.
requirements.verify: integration/security: permitted fixture data operators can delete/restore; readers/members, forged operators and revoked/expired grants are denied with no durable lifecycle effect.

requirements.text: Forget and retention expiry must durably tombstone authoritative records and initiate required dependent invalidation rather than merely hiding a query result.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery: delete/expire real persisted records, recreate services, inspect durable tombstones/invalidation work and confirm future recall/publication remains unavailable.

requirements.text: Source access revocation must suppress affected future context and derived disclosure unless an explicit independently valid publication grant permits the copied artifact.
requirements.verify: integration/security/concurrency: revoke a source before and during recall/generation/derived processing; future content is suppressed; any supported copied-publication exception requires a separately recorded, current grant.

requirements.text: Membership removal must invalidate affected access caches/current grants and block new reads, context compilation and publication under that member's authority.
requirements.verify: integration/security/concurrency: remove a fixture member with active retrieval and cached context; test both race orders and subsequent reads/outputs, including recreation, for zero disallowed disclosure.

requirements.text: Sensitive source dependencies must be tracked so deletion, expiry or revocation invalidates or rebuilds every supported affected descendant, including nested summaries, indexes, caches and candidate/fixture/procedure records when supported.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery: persist a multi-level dependency graph, apply each restriction, inspect durable affected descendants and actual retrieval/output refusal; unsupported descendant classes are explicitly inventoried rather than claimed qualified.

requirements.text: Delayed or replayed indexing/enrichment/invalidation work must revalidate current deletion and authorization before applying results and must not resurrect forbidden content.
requirements.verify: integration/concurrency/recovery: queue jobs before delete/revoke/correct, release them afterward and after processor restart, including duplicate delivery; canonical/derived reads stay denied or current and no stale writer restores restricted bytes.

requirements.text: Propagation failures must preserve durable pending invalidation and retry it idempotently while canonical current-authority checks already block disallowed reads/publication.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery: fail descendant processing after partial progress, observe truthful pending state and immediate serving denial, recreate processor and retry to completion without duplicate mutations or content resurrection.

requirements.text: Correction/supersession must update affected summaries/indexes and expose the current revision without allowing a stale projection to redefine the accepted record.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery: correct real source-backed knowledge with an old cached/indexed answer, process/retry derived updates and inspect canonical current recall before/after propagation.

requirements.text: A forget response must truthfully report affected active/derived records, pending propagation, external copies and disclosed retention restrictions; it must not claim to recall delivered bytes or erase every historical backup/export immediately.
requirements.verify: integration/review: exercise permitted, denied, repeated and partially propagated forget requests; inspect user/operator impact/status fields and documented external/backup limitations.

requirements.text: Delete/revoke races with reads, writes and background jobs must preserve current restrictions and monotonic tombstones; repeated deletion must not recreate content or produce incompatible duplicate effects.
requirements.verify: integration/concurrency/recovery: observe real contested operations in both orderings, duplicate delete and crashes around tombstone/invalidation writes; finite suite has zero future prohibited recall/publication/resurrection.

requirements.text: Supported live editable files, recoverable drafts, committed artifacts and knowledge commits must expose distinct save/checkpoint states; a memory commit or volume snapshot must not imply unsaved editor work is saved.
requirements.verify: integration/review: persist/checkpoint supported classes separately, interrupt uncommitted editing, recreate service and inspect actual recovery plus Saved/unsaved/uncheckpointed status per class.

requirements.text: Canonical file promotion must use expected base revision, validation and an authorized merge/apply operation; incompatible concurrent promotions must not silently replace a newer accepted version.
requirements.verify: integration/concurrency: race two actual promotions from one base, verify exact accepted bytes/manifest and explicit losing conflict; unauthorized promotion leaves canonical files unchanged.

requirements.text: Supported saved task drafts must survive as recoverable versions visible only to their authorized Space audience; stale drafts must remain comparable/rebasable or retainable as a variant rather than overwrite a newer canonical version.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery/security: save a draft, recreate service, inspect original version and audience, then reconnect a stale draft against a newer accepted version and verify conflict/retention without overwrite.

requirements.text: Confirmed committed knowledge and artifact bytes/manifests must survive service/worker recreation; recovery of uncommitted or uncheckpointed work must reflect its declared class rather than claim durability.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery: close/recreate actual service/process/storage clients after confirmed saves and interrupted writes, then read exact committed bytes/records and accurately expose unavailable unsaved work.

requirements.text: Recreated or recovered writers must respect current revision and Task/Run/runtime fencing generations; old writers must not publish over replacements or regain revoked permissions.
requirements.verify: integration/concurrency/recovery: retain a stale writer across actual recreation/restore, advance the authoritative revision/generation and attempt save/promotion; denied writes leave current canonical state unchanged.

requirements.text: Restore must recover actual encrypted persisted payloads and canonical records into fresh owned fixture storage after service recreation, making eligible surviving knowledge and committed files usable.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery: create real backup/checkpoint files and canonical metadata, restore into a fresh owned destination and recreated service, compare surviving records/manifests/bytes and perform a real restored saved-decision Ask; in-memory serialization alone fails.

requirements.text: Restore must preserve cross-store consistency and block affected serving for inconsistent manifests, corrupt/missing bytes or incomplete backup data.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery/security: restore a complete backup plus corrupt, missing-byte, mismatched-manifest and incomplete variants; assert exact good recovery and inspectable blocked state with no dangling published record in each bad case.

requirements.text: Current deletion ledger, retention policy, membership and source revocation must be applied before restored user access, workspace rehydration or derived-index rebuilding; post-backup deleted, expired or revoked data must remain unavailable.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery/concurrency: back up real data, delete/expire/revoke afterward, restore older copies and observe the serving/rebuild barrier; eligible survivors succeed but restricted records/files/descendants cannot enter inputs or outputs.

requirements.text: Freshness/conflict checks must prevent a restored superseded decision from being presented as the current accepted claim after a post-backup correction.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery: back up revision N, correct to N+1, restore the old backup and Ask; canonical current authority resolves the accepted revision or blocks serving with a stated freshness limitation, never silently presents N as current.

requirements.text: An older backup must not become current deletion/revocation/policy authority; if current authority/freshness cannot be established, restoration must keep affected serving blocked with inspectable recovery state.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery/security: restore with current ledger/policy missing, unavailable or stale, and crash around barrier transitions; no affected serving occurs until authoritative freshness is proven.

requirements.text: Interrupted and repeated restore operations must recover safely without partial unauthorized serving, duplicate canonical effects or resurrection.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery/concurrency: interrupt actual restore before/after metadata/byte/restriction phases, recreate operator/service and repeat the bound operation; inspect persisted recovery state, canonical identities and served content.

requirements.text: Storage restore must not replay external writes, stale approvals, disconnected input or unsent drafts, and must not blindly restore credentials/browser sessions or revoked methods.
requirements.verify: integration/recovery/security: include fixture stale operation/approval/generation/credential references, restore and inspect dispatch/model/write counters plus authority state; recovery causes no effect replay or grant/session resurrection.

requirements.text: The local solution and evidence must define commit/checkpoint/recovery semantics per supported data class, record actual last successful backup/checkpoint and the measured recovery boundary, and document a tested restore/recovery procedure.
requirements.verify: review/integration/recovery: compare class inventory and operating procedure to executed crash/restore observations, acknowledged revisions and checkpoint timestamps; document what was preserved and what was lost without invented production RPO/RTO.

requirements.text: Supported recovery/error responses must state what happened, what was preserved/unexecuted and the next authorized action/resolver without exposing restricted operational details.
requirements.verify: integration/review: inspect allowed/denied/conflict/expiry/index-outage/encryption/restore-failure outcomes for safe status and actionable resolver; no indefinite success spinner or invented completed action.

requirements.text: The increment must add g1-storage/ with a build and g1-storage/scripts/check.mjs, docs/planning/g1-f05-plan.md and docs/evidence/g1-f05-acceptance.md.
requirements.verify: review/integration: controller executes node g1-storage/scripts/check.mjs and verifies requested plan/evidence paths exist and describe the implemented candidate.

requirements.text: The storage check must strictly build current sources before running mandatory nonempty real behavioral suites for AF-07, UX-01 and storage/restore, following the accepted identity-check conventions.
requirements.source: Current goal, Required deliverables; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f05-storage/product-brief.md:61; g1-identity/scripts/check.mjs, strict build and mandatory suites
requirements.verify: integration: controller runs the check from a fresh candidate/dependency state; verify strict compiler success and actual executed assertions for canonical storage, saved answers and restore instead of prebuilt/canned outputs.

requirements.text: The storage check must fail on missing suites, build failure, failed/cancelled tests, skips/TODO, stale generated outputs or failed ownership-checked cleanup.
requirements.verify: integration/review: inspect and exercise harness failure cases for each condition; require successful nonempty execution per mandatory behavior group and zero failed/cancelled/skipped/TODO tests.

requirements.text: Mandatory acceptance must exercise real positive, negative, concurrency and recovery behavior; finite suites require zero unauthorized disclosures/mutations, silent lost updates, duplicate canonical commits, resurrected restricted content and Ask computer starts while authorized useful journeys succeed.
requirements.verify: integration/e2e/security: controller observes actual stored bytes/records, generator inputs, manifests, competing writers, propagation and recreation/restore; assert prohibited counters zero and positive outcomes, not schema/label-only tests or refuse-all behavior.

requirements.text: All work must remain additive and preserve accepted G0/G1-local/G1-foundations/G1-F02 checks, protected files, raw evidence and historical acceptance/ledger statements without weakening, deletion or overwrite.
requirements.verify: regression/review: unchanged retained-source/raw hash guards and existing required controller checks pass; inspect diff for only new increment or authorized additive paths, leaving previous worktree/controller state untouched.

requirements.text: Only fresh current-candidate controller-run checks count as acceptance evidence; Electron/GUI regressions must run via loop_check outside the sandbox, and sandbox failure must not justify skipping them.
requirements.verify: regression/review: inspect controller job definitions/results for unchanged identity, foundation and retained baselines including Electron; local diagnostics are labelled separately from acceptance.

requirements.text: The acceptance evidence must identify exact candidate, check definitions/commands, environment/local profile, supported behavior, complete raw result references and failures plus explicit unresolved qualification gates; author text is not an independent verdict.
requirements.verify: review: audit evidence-to-current-controller-output links and hashes/fingerprints, preserve raw failures, and confirm no unsigned author claim substitutes for registered reviews or controller completion.

requirements.text: The increment evidence package must include a versioned requirements/test mapping, pinned dependency/lock/version and license/update inventory, operations/recovery instructions, data-flow/threat changes and rollback limitations.
requirements.verify: review: inspect requested plan/evidence and linked increment documents against actual build dependencies, owner boundaries, supported classes and test obligations; rollback must preserve external effects/tombstones rather than imply undo.

requirements.text: Paid model/product APIs, new paid/cloud resources, real credentials, remote/shared/production deployment or release, messages to people, nonreproducible data deletion/overwrite, credential/security/access changes and published-history/branch destructive actions must remain off without prior loop_ask(kind=approval) for the exact action.
requirements.source: Current goal, Constraints and Needs approval first; docs/loop/agent-fabric-g1-f05-storage/product-brief.md:82,94
requirements.verify: review/security: inspect actions, scripts and evidence for local synthetic-only execution, disabled external routes and official approval records before any restricted action; no elapsed-time or inferred approval.

requirements.text: Destructive, retention and restore tests may use only owned repository-reproducible synthetic data/ephemeral keys and must perform bounded ownership-checked cleanup without removing unowned processes, services, volumes or databases.
requirements.verify: integration/security/review: inspect fixture identities and cleanup observations, preserve preexisting fixture census, exercise cleanup failure and verify no global prune/kill/unowned path deletion or external fallback.

requirements.text: This requirements-stage turn must record source-cited atomic requirements and runnable verification in loop_requirements(final=true), without designing or writing product code or editing .loop state by hand.
requirements.verify: review: inspect recorded requirements and turn diff/tool history; stage submission is requirements-only and controller owns progression.

requirements.text: The local increment should provide a documented user/operator entry point for save, Ask, conflict, forget and restore with understandable scope, source, save status and next actions; a new GUI is not required.
requirements.verify: review/integration: follow the documented local journey against actual fixture persistence and inspect user-readable outputs; any exception to this intended default is documented.

requirements.text: The increment should provide an obligation-to-test matrix separating canonical knowledge behavior, derived propagation, volume/checkpoint behavior and remaining external qualification for AF-07 and UX-01.
requirements.verify: review: trace each recorded mandatory obligation to an executed assertion or explicit pending external gate in the matrix; no interface-only coverage is counted as behavior.

requirements.text: The increment should explain recoverable versus unsaved work and propagation retry/failure states, and that retained storage can continue after Task Stop, archive or suspension without implying deletion or zero charges.
requirements.verify: review/integration: inspect local save/recovery/lifecycle explanations and existing model charge contract integration; document retained fixture classes and clarify that actual cloud billing is not measured.

requirements.text: Optional deterministic failure schedules/fixture variants may improve required contention, deletion ordering and recovery coverage but cannot replace mandatory journeys or expand external scope.
requirements.verify: review: if added, map each optional fixture to an existing obligation and preserve mandatory coverage and local-only limits.

requirements.text: Acceptance must explicitly leave actual object-store/volume encryption, managed key custody/rotation, provider backup durability, real-filesystem/runtime crash consistency, multi-host availability and disaster recovery unqualified unless their actual external environments have been approved and tested.
requirements.verify: review: list each untested deployment/storage guarantee with missing environment evidence and next gate; local encrypted-file/restore results qualify only their finite local profile.

requirements.text: No enterprise retention duration, legal-hold rule, region, backup or key policy may be invented from fixture defaults; production policy/data-flow decisions remain explicit authorized-human gates.
requirements.verify: review/human: document fixture durations/keys as test parameters and unresolved external decisions as pending; before external use obtain the actual authorized policy-owner decision through loop_ask.

requirements.text: Real download/stream revocation and direct-link exposure windows remain external qualification gates; any supported online-revocation claim requires an authorization-checking delivery path, and no claim may recall already delivered bytes.
requirements.verify: review/security: inventory implemented serving paths and local reauthorization tests; explicitly mark real broker/stream/signed-link guarantees pending until approved-provider revocation tests and exposure windows exist.

requirements.text: Qualified remote no-VM service isolation and actual Linux/runtime/egress boundaries are deferred to G1-F06; local route counters/capability tests must not be advertised as OS, cloud or hardware containment.
requirements.verify: review: evidence separates executable local source/route behavior from missing real host/kernel/image/service isolation; next qualification gate is named without running remote resources in this stage.

requirements.text: Formal enterprise SSO/current-directory qualification and real human approval judgment remain unqualified by local synthetic identity and operator fixtures.
requirements.verify: review: acceptance identifies reused local identity qualification and explicitly pending enterprise SSO/human gates rather than equating fixtures with production identity.

requirements.text: The deterministic local saved-decision answer route must not claim real supplier/model conformance, inference quality, billing reconciliation or answer-quality qualification.
requirements.verify: review: label actual answer adapter/profile and synthetic accounting; list missing approved real model/gateway/data-region evidence and leave external enablement gated.

requirements.text: Physical device/sleep/signed-distribution/accessibility and full three-client journeys remain G1-F07 qualification rather than an F05 local storage claim.
requirements.verify: review: preserve required existing client regressions while acceptance records missing physical/platform and representative-user evidence; no new GUI is demanded by F05.

requirements.text: Full G2 semantic retrieval-quality/no-memory comparison, enterprise curation/inspector breadth, complete connector/JML/legal-hold/billing/schedule/Fleet lifecycle, G3 creation/computer use and G4 Reflect release are outside this increment; local lineage/recall/conflict/delete/revocation cannot be deferred with them.
requirements.verify: review: separate baseline implemented requirements and later-depth/external obligations in plan/evidence; unrelated modules and ledger rows remain pending, with no omission of mandatory F05 behaviors.

requirements.text: Numerical retention periods, performance percentiles, production RPO/RTO and legal/SLA guarantees must not be invented; report observed local recovery measurements and leave actual production load/backup/revocation and pilot timing qualification pending.
requirements.verify: review/performance: audit evidence for measured boundaries, actual samples/conditions and explicit pending production measurements; roadmap pilot numbers are identified as targets, not local achieved SLAs.

requirements.text: High-severity authorization, isolation, stale-approval or duplicate-effect defects must block the affected qualification/release profile; advertise only actually qualified combinations and never claim full G1/G2 or complete AF-07/UX-12–17 from local F05 results.
requirements.verify: review/security: retain unresolved findings and profile limitations visibly; confirm controller acceptance and independent review stay separate from author evidence and unaffected ledger obligations are not closed.

requirements.text: Recall must assess current source validity, freshness, supersession and conflict before selecting/ranking eligible records; relevant but stale, disputed or unauthorized sources cannot become certain current decisions.
requirements.verify: integration: change source revision/validity and knowledge head with an older index/context present; inspect exact source-backed answer/manifest and visible conflict/limitation, with authorized current decisions still retrievable.
